newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino Land convertible raises US$126.75mln.
newsitem.headline: Sino Land convertible raises US$126.75mln.

text.p: Sino Land Co Ltd raised US$126.75 million after expenses through the issue of convertible bonds due 2002, the company said in an announcement published on Monday.
The company issued US$130 million in convertible bonds which carry a coupon of four percent a year and are convertible into ordinary shares.
The issue was completed on Friday and all bonds were issued at par. The Luxembourg Stock Exchange has approved the listing of the bonds, the notice said.
Shares of Sino Land closed HK$0.25 lower at HK$7.20 on Friday.
